units.source_text: “虽然没有，但我以前也说过，我不愿意妨碍小姐的幸福，哪怕是一星半点。”

en.t: “It is not that there is anything, but as I said before, I do not want to interfere with your happiness, miss, not even in the slightest.”

units.source_text: 苗子压低嗓音，“我想索性隐姓埋名算了。”

en.t: Naeko lowered her voice. “I think I may as well hide my name and identity altogether.”
